title: Ratha Yatra
description: Celebrate Lord Jagannath’s grand chariot festival with bhajans, seva and simple home offerings.

title: Guru Purnima
description: A sacred day to express gratitude toward gurus, teachers and guides who illuminate dharma.

title: Raksha Bandhan
description: A family festival celebrating protection, affection and sacred bonds.

title: Krishna Janmashtami
description: Mark the birth of Lord Krishna with bhajans, fasting, midnight prayer and joyful devotion.

title: Ganesh Chaturthi
description: Welcome Lord Ganesh home with devotion, aarti and prayers for auspicious beginnings.

title: Navratri Begins
description: Nine nights of devotion to Maa Durga, focusing on inner shakti, fasting and bhakti.

title: Dussehra
description: Celebrate the victory of dharma over adharma and renew your resolve for righteous action.

title: Dhanteras
description: Auspicious day for Lakshmi puja, gratitude and preparing the home for Deepavali.

title: Diwali
description: Festival of lights celebrating hope, homecoming, prosperity and spiritual renewal.

title: Chhath Puja
description: A deeply revered festival dedicated to Surya Dev and Chhathi Maiya with gratitude and discipline.
